recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, centered portrait of a man with dark curly hair against a soft-focus sunset horizon. He wears a deep purple velvet garment and holds a brass trumpet. The composition features a dual typographic approach: a rigid, wide-tracked slab serif at the top and a fluid, white script signature in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Purple velvet texture against the warm golden glow of the horizon
Rigid geometric header text contrasting with organic script signature
Brass instrument highlights echoing the horizon line light
Direct eye contact creating a central focal point
coreInvariants: Horizon line positioned at eye level
Deep purple color palette for clothing
Soft, diffused studio lighting on the face
Presence of a brass musical instrument

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the top header, down to the signature, then following the arm to the trumpet.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image consisting of the sky and horizon.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White (script text) and Pink (header text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purple and sunset, with deep shadows in the hair and clothing folds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended Slab Serif and Expressive Script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Wide horizontal expansion, heavy slab serifs, uniform stroke weight.
Signature: Rapid, fluid motion with varying line thickness and long vertical descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' in the script has a large, looping flourish that extends above the x-height.
The 'y' in the script features a long, straight descender.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural contrast between rigid geometry and fluid hand-drawn expression.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text
The specific deep purple of the velvet

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with dark curly hair wearing a deep purple velvet shirt, holding a brass trumpet. The background is a soft-focus sunset with a clear horizontal glow between a dark ground and a blue-to-orange sky gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase slab-serif text in pink at the very top with wide tracking. Add a large, white, fluid hand-written signature in the upper right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the purple velvet texture visible?
Is the horizon line at eye level?
Is the top text widely spaced?
Is the signature white and gestural?

Check that the pink text is legible against the blue sky.
Verify the signature looks hand-drawn, not like a standard font.
